system.description:
Turn incoming physical harm into staying power, drawing strength from impact. Primarily resists conventional blows. See official rules for limits and interactions.

  • Level 1: Absorbs 5 damage
  • Level 2: Absorbs 10 damage
  • Level 3: Absorbs 15 damage
  • Level 4: Absorbs 20 damage
  • Level 5: Absorbs 25 damage
  • Level 6: Absorbs 30 damage
